# AGENCY

> Homes for autonomous agents — a self-hosted container-hosting website and
> provisioning API on your Proxmox VE node. First home free; later homes
> quoted in USDC/USDT with a unique payment reference.
>
> Everything below resolves on the node's own origin. This index follows the
> llmstxt.org spec; `/llms-full.txt` is the whole reference in one fetch.

## Introduction

- [Agent Home Overview](/): AGENCY spins up small, dedicated, unprivileged LXC
  container homes for AI agents — 2 GB RAM, up to 8 GB disk, full shared CPU
  pool. The first home provisions instantly; every later home gets a
  machine-readable USDC/USDT quote with a unique payment memo.

## Agents

- [Agent Reference](/docs/agents): drive AGENCY from a shell — endpoints,
  authentication headers, the machine-readable error envelope, content
  negotiation, and a complete curl walkthrough from request to running home.
- [Complete Reference](/llms-full.txt): this index plus the full agent
  reference concatenated, for a single-fetch agent bootstrap.

## API (JSON)

- [Health](/api/health): node CPU/memory, storage free, live + metered agent
  counts, plans, free-tier usage, Proxmox reachability. No auth.
- [Plans](/api/plans): the plan tiers — RAM / disk / cores → USD per month —
  plus the billing periods (weekly / fortnightly / monthly) and period
  prices. No auth.
- [Stacks](/api/stacks): the curate-your-stack catalog — baked groups,
  selectable add-ons, venv option, max. No auth.
- [Agents](/api/agents): request a home (POST, needs `X-Agency-Secret`;
  body may pick a `plan`), list all agents (GET, no PII), inspect one
  (`GET /api/agents/<id>`).
- [Admin](/api/agents/<id>/<action>): `confirm-payment` (credit + provision),
  `statement` (the billing ledger), `renew` (add credit, restart a halted
  home), `schedule-destroy` (TTL / destroy-at / cancel), `retry`, `destroy`.
  All need `X-Admin-Key`.

## Billing

Homes are **paid up front per billing period** — weekly, fortnightly or
monthly — at the plan's monthly rate. Each home carries a prepaid window
(`paid_until`); with `warn_before_s` left it is flagged `expiring`, and at
the deadline the container is stopped and the home `halted` until renewed
or destroyed. Free homes get the first period(s) free (`free_periods`).

## Conventions

Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header; every error body embeds it and
a stable machine `code` plus a `hint`. Pages answer in markdown when you ask for
it (`Accept: text/markdown`, or any non-browser client). More in
[the agent reference](/docs/agents).
